rights_scope: MIT applies to adapter software; upstream data rights are source-specific

evaluations.task: Add a source-linked funding review to an existing agent or workflow
evaluations.success_evidence: An independent evaluator retains a cited result or explicit coverage gap and confirms it helped their task
evaluations.repeat_evidence: The same evaluator repeats the task on a different day with source dates and revisions preserved

evaluations.audience: Financial-data platforms, treasury and bank-risk teams
evaluations.task: Review available disclosures and evidence gaps for one covered institution
evaluations.success_evidence: A named reviewer retains sources and a useful follow-up queue for their own covered selection
evaluations.repeat_evidence: A later review distinguishes changed disclosures, unchanged evidence and unresolved gaps

evaluations.audience: Trading firms, quantitative researchers and market-risk teams
evaluations.task: Retain an indicative BTC liquidity review for supported sizes and venues
evaluations.success_evidence: A researcher retains the observation time, supported size, venue, access status and limitations
evaluations.repeat_evidence: The same research task is repeated on a different day without treating a stale or withheld observation as a current quote

limits: Dataset, institution, venue and historical coverage must be checked per task
Public APIs do not establish redistribution rights or a production service agreement
Source freshness and missingness remain attached to each observation
No order routing, executable quote, credit rating or investment recommendation
A compatible client is not a platform endorsement or an accepted partnership
